title: Coulthart detained by CBP after Grusch story

tellings.quote: Yeah, after I did the Grusch story, I was detained and held by CBP.

plain: Ross Coulthart, a reporter who broke a story in 2023 about a man named Grusch, says that afterwards he was stopped and held at the US border by CBP, the US Customs and Border Protection agency. He tells it himself, as something that happened to him. He shares it as a sign that reporting on this subject brought trouble from his own government's border officials.
